package handlers

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strings"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/api/v1/middleware"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/curriculum"
)

type curriculumPlanner interface {
	Execute(context.Context, curriculum.PlanInput) (curriculum.PlanResult, error)
}

type diagnosticPlanner interface {
	Complete(context.Context, string, string) (domain.TeacherDiagnosticPlacementState, error)
	Plan(context.Context, string, string) (domain.TeacherDiagnosticPlacementState, error)
}

type CurriculumHandler struct {
	Planner    curriculumPlanner
	Diagnostic diagnosticPlanner
}

func (handler CurriculumHandler) Plan(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		writeError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized")
		return
	}
	var request struct {
		DiagnosticPlanID string                     `json:"diagnostic_plan_id"`
		GoalCode         string                     `json:"goal_code"`
		DesiredOutcome   string                     `json:"desired_outcome"`
		RequestedTargets []domain.LearningTargetRef `json:"requested_targets"`
		Constraints      curriculum.PlanConstraints `json:"constraints"`
		Reason           curriculum.PlanReason      `json:"reason"`
	}
	body, readErr := io.ReadAll(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 16<<10))
	if readErr != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid request body")
		return
	}
	var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
	if json.Unmarshal(body, &fields) != nil || fields == nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid request body")
		return
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(strings.NewReader(string(body)))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&request); err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid request body")
		return
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "request body must contain one JSON object")
		return
	}
	if _, diagnostic := fields["diagnostic_plan_id"]; diagnostic {
		if len(fields) != 1 || request.DiagnosticPlanID == "" || r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key") != request.DiagnosticPlanID {
			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "diagnostic planning accepts only diagnostic_plan_id")
			return
		}
		if handler.Diagnostic == nil {
			writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "diagnostic planner unavailable")
			return
		}
		result, err := handler.Diagnostic.Plan(r.Context(), studentID, request.DiagnosticPlanID)
		writeDiagnosticPlacementResult(w, result, err)
		return
	}
	if handler.Planner == nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "curriculum planner unavailable")
		return
	}
	reason := request.Reason
	if reason == "" {
		reason = curriculum.PlanReasonInitial
	}
	result, err := handler.Planner.Execute(r.Context(), curriculum.PlanInput{
		StudentID: studentID, IdempotencyKey: strings.TrimSpace(r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key")),
		GoalCode: request.GoalCode, DesiredOutcome: request.DesiredOutcome,
		Targets: request.RequestedTargets, Constraints: request.Constraints, Reason: reason,
	})
	switch {
	case err == nil:
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusAccepted, result)
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherGenerationConflict):
		writeError(w, http.StatusConflict, "learning path version conflict")
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrInvalidCurriculum), errors.Is(err, domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext):
		writeError(w, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "curriculum cannot be planned from current state")
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrCurriculumUnavailable), errors.Is(err, domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable):
		writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "curriculum dependency unavailable")
	default:
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to plan learning path")
	}
}
